alt.en: A teal glass cube holding a sphere, an AI agent, stands at the center. A dashed orange line runs into it from a gray tool tile beside a yellow warning sign, and a second orange line with packets arcs from the cube to a gray cloud. A violet bar chart with three falling bars stands at the front right.
alt.zh: 画面中央是一个装有球体的青色玻璃立方体，代表 AI 智能体。一条橙色虚线从黄色警示牌旁的灰色工具卡片进入立方体，另一条带数据包的橙色弧线从立方体飞向灰色云朵。右前方是三根逐级下降的紫色柱状图。

caption.en: Illustration: a poisoned tool description entering an agent, which sends a secret on toward an attacker's endpoint, with a bar chart for the falling rates of tool dispatch, endpoint contact and confirmed exfiltration the study reports. It does not depict any of the twelve frameworks, the mcpvenom tool or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the reported attacks succeed as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：一条被投毒的工具描述进入智能体，智能体再把秘密送往攻击者端点；柱状图表示研究报告的工具调用、联系端点与确认外传三个逐级下降的比例。图中不描绘十二个框架中的任何一个、mcpvenom 工具或经过测试的部署，也不表明报告的攻击如所述那样成功。
